name: fnaf-replica
description: FNAF Replica: an unofficial, non-commercial 4-player co-op fan game.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c red,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit && tsc -p scripts --noEmit
